px AS (
  SELECT p.SYMBOL, p.DATE, p.CLOSE, p.VOLUME,
    LN(p.CLOSE / NULLIF(LAG(p.CLOSE) OVER (PARTITION BY p.SYMBOL ORDER BY p.DATE),0)) AS lr
  FROM FINANCE.STOCKS.SP500_PRICES p
  WHERE p.CLOSE > 0
),
agg AS (
  SELECT SYMBOL, MAX_BY(CLOSE, DATE) AS spot, AVG(VOLUME) AS adv,
    STDDEV(lr) * SQRT(252) AS rvol, COUNT(lr) AS nobs
  FROM px GROUP BY SYMBOL
),
uni0 AS (
  SELECT a.SYMBOL, c.NAME, c.SECTOR, a.spot, a.adv,
    GREATEST(a.rvol, 0.08) AS iv,                    -- decimal 1m implied-vol proxy
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.adv DESC NULLS LAST) AS liq_rank
  FROM agg a JOIN FINANCE.STOCKS.COMPANIES c ON c.SYMBOL = a.SYMBOL
  WHERE a.spot IS NOT NULL AND a.rvol IS NOT NULL AND a.nobs >= 40
),
und AS (
  SELECT u.SYMBOL, u.NAME, u.SECTOR, u.spot, u.adv, u.iv, u.liq_rank,
    ROUND(u.iv*100,1) AS iv_1m_pct,
    CASE WHEN u.iv*100 <= 30 THEN 'Low (<=30)'
         WHEN u.iv*100 <  50 THEN 'Mid (30-50)' ELSE 'High (>=50)' END AS vol_tier,
    (MOD(ABS(HASH(u.SYMBOL, 11)), 100) < 11) AS has_earn,    -- ~24 names; ~20 survive the spanning filter
    DATEADD('day', 1 + MOD(ABS(HASH(u.SYMBOL, 13)), 15),
            (SELECT snap_dt FROM snap)) AS earn_date,
    ROUND(0.04 + MOD(ABS(HASH(u.SYMBOL, 17)), 100)/1000.0, 4) AS earn_move  -- 0.040..0.139
  FROM uni0 u
  WHERE u.liq_rank <= 220
),
raw AS (
  SELECT SEQ4() AS i FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 775))
),
pick AS (
  SELECT i,
    -- first N positions seed one-per-underlier (guarantees full coverage); the rest are
    -- liquidity-weighted (POWER(u01,1.7) concentrates on liquid names) => realistic clustering
    CASE WHEN i < 220 THEN i+1
         ELSE 1 + FLOOR(POWER(MOD(ABS(HASH(i,1)),100000)/100000.0, 1.7) * (220-1)) END AS u_rank,
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,2)),2)=0 THEN 'Call' ELSE 'Put' END AS opt_type,
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,3)),100) < 72 THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS side_sign,  -- ~72% long => long gamma/vega
    1.00 + (MOD(ABS(HASH(i,4)),21)-10)/100.0 AS moneyness,                    -- 0.90..1.10
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,5)),100) < 10 THEN 7
         WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,5)),100) < 35 THEN 14
         WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,5)),100) < 60 THEN 30
         WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,5)),100) < 80 THEN 45
         WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(i,5)),100) < 92 THEN 60 ELSE 90 END AS dte,
    6 + MOD(ABS(HASH(i,6)),60) AS base_ct
  FROM raw
),
attr AS (
  SELECT p.i, u.SYMBOL, u.NAME, u.SECTOR, u.spot, u.iv, u.iv_1m_pct, u.vol_tier,
    u.has_earn, u.earn_date, u.earn_move, u.liq_rank,
    p.opt_type, p.side_sign, p.moneyness, p.dte,
    ROUND(u.spot * p.moneyness, 2) AS strike,
    p.dte/365.0 AS tyr,
    GREATEST(u.iv * (1 + 0.12*(1.00 - p.moneyness)), 0.05) AS sig,       -- mild vol skew
    CEIL(p.base_ct * (1 + (220 - u.liq_rank)/220.0)) AS contracts,
    (u.has_earn AND u.earn_date <= DATEADD('day', p.dte, (SELECT snap_dt FROM snap))) AS spans_earn
  FROM pick p JOIN und u ON u.liq_rank = p.u_rank
),

  SELECT a.*, ((LN(spot/strike) + 0.5*sig*sig*tyr)/NULLIF(sig*SQRT(tyr),0)) AS d1, (((LN(spot/strike) + 0.5*sig*sig*tyr)/NULLIF(sig*SQRT(tyr),0))) - a.sig*SQRT(a.tyr) AS d2
  FROM attr a
),
pos AS (
  SELECT b.i AS pos_id, b.SYMBOL, b.NAME, b.SECTOR, b.opt_type, b.side_sign,
    CASE WHEN b.side_sign=1 THEN 'Long' ELSE 'Short' END AS side,
    b.strike, b.moneyness, b.dte, b.tyr, b.spot, b.sig, b.iv_1m_pct, b.vol_tier,
    b.contracts, 100 AS mult, b.has_earn, b.earn_date, b.earn_move, b.spans_earn, b.liq_rank,
    -- per-share BS price
    CASE WHEN b.opt_type='Call'
         THEN b.spot*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(b.d1)))) - b.strike*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(b.d2))))
         ELSE b.strike*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(-b.d2)))) - b.spot*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(-b.d1)))) END AS price,

    CASE WHEN b.opt_type='Call' THEN (1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(b.d1)))) ELSE (1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(b.d1))))-1 END AS delta,
    (EXP(-0.5*(b.d1)*(b.d1))/2.5066282746310002)/NULLIF(b.spot*b.sig*SQRT(b.tyr),0) AS gamma,
    b.spot*(EXP(-0.5*(b.d1)*(b.d1))/2.5066282746310002)*SQRT(b.tyr)/100.0 AS vega,          -- per 1 vol point
    -(b.spot*(EXP(-0.5*(b.d1)*(b.d1))/2.5066282746310002)*b.sig)/(2*NULLIF(SQRT(b.tyr),0))/365.0 AS theta
  FROM bs b
),

vshock AS (SELECT column1 AS vs FROM (VALUES (-0.4),(-0.3),(-0.2),(-0.1),(0.0),(0.1),(0.2),(0.3),(0.4)))
SELECT p.pos_id AS POS_ID, p.SYMBOL, p.SECTOR, p.opt_type AS OPT_TYPE, p.SIDE AS SIDE,

  -- integer percents: the KPI cards look a cell up by exact equality, which is not safe

  -- the header renders "-40%".
  CAST(ROUND(s.ss*100) AS INT) AS SPOT_SHOCK_PCT,
  CAST(ROUND(v.vs*100) AS INT) AS VOL_SHOCK_PCT,
  ROUND((CASE WHEN opt_type='Call' THEN (spot*(1+ss))*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(((LN((spot*(1+ss))/strike) + 0.5*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*tyr)/NULLIF((GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*SQRT(tyr),0)))))) - strike*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(((((LN((spot*(1+ss))/strike) + 0.5*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*tyr)/NULLIF((GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*SQRT(tyr),0))) - (GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*SQRT(tyr)))))) ELSE strike*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(-(((((LN((spot*(1+ss))/strike) + 0.5*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*tyr)/NULLIF((GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*SQRT(tyr),0))) - (GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*SQRT(tyr))))))) - (spot*(1+ss))*(1.0/(1.0+EXP(-1.702*(-(((LN((spot*(1+ss))/strike) + 0.5*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*(GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*tyr)/NULLIF((GREATEST(sig*(1+vs),0.01))*SQRT(tyr),0))))))) END - p.price) * p.side_sign * p.contracts * 100) AS PNL
FROM pos p CROSS JOIN sshock s CROSS JOIN vshock v","type":"custom-sql"}

    GREATEST(a.rvol, 0.08) AS iv,                    -- decimal 1m implied-vol proxy
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.adv DESC NULLS LAST) AS liq_rank
  FROM agg a JOIN FINANCE.STOCKS.COMPANIES c ON c.SYMBOL = a.SYMBOL
  WHERE a.spot IS NOT NULL AND a.rvol IS NOT NULL AND a.nobs >= 40
),
und AS (
  SELECT u.SYMBOL, u.NAME, u.SECTOR, u.spot, u.adv, u.iv, u.liq_rank,
    ROUND(u.iv*100,1) AS iv_1m_pct,
    CASE WHEN u.iv*100 <= 30 THEN 'Low (<=30)'
         WHEN u.iv*100 <  50 THEN 'Mid (30-50)' ELSE 'High (>=50)' END AS vol_tier,
    (MOD(ABS(HASH(u.SYMBOL, 11)), 100) < 11) AS has_earn,    -- ~24 names; ~20 survive the spanning filter
    DATEADD('day', 1 + MOD(ABS(HASH(u.SYMBOL, 13)), 15),
            (SELECT snap_dt FROM snap)) AS earn_date,
    ROUND(0.04 + MOD(ABS(HASH(u.SYMBOL, 17)), 100)/1000.0, 4) AS earn_move  -- 0.040..0.139
  FROM uni0 u
  WHERE u.liq_rank <= 220
)
SELECT (SELECT snap_dt FROM snap) AS SNAPSHOT_DT,
  SYMBOL, NAME, SECTOR, ROUND(spot,2) AS SPOT, ROUND(adv) AS ADV,
  iv_1m_pct AS IV_1M_PCT, vol_tier AS VOL_TIER, liq_rank AS LIQ_RANK,
  has_earn AS HAS_EARNINGS,
  CASE WHEN has_earn THEN earn_date END AS EARNINGS_DATE,
  CASE WHEN has_earn THEN ROUND(earn_move*100,1) END AS EARN_IMPLIED_MOVE_PCT
FROM und ORDER BY liq_rank","type":"custom-sql"}

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"src-quarters","definition":"WITH cal_m AS (
  SELECT id + 1 AS idx, add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id) AS ps, last_day(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS pe,
         date_format(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id), 'yyyy-MM') AS period,
         date_format(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id), 'yyMM') AS yymm,
         date_format(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id), 'MMM yyyy') AS mlabel,
         concat(CAST(year(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING), '-Q', CAST(quarter(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING)) AS quarter,
         concat('Q', CAST(quarter(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING), ' ', CAST(year(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING)) AS qlabel,
         pmod(month(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) - 1, 3) + 1 AS miq
  FROM (SELECT CAST(id AS INT) AS id FROM range(24)) r)
SELECT quarter, qlabel AS quarter_label, period AS quarter_end_period, pe AS quarter_end,
  CAST(idx / 3 AS INT) AS quarter_index, year(ps) AS fiscal_year,
  concat(CAST(year(add_months(ps, -3)) AS STRING), '-Q', CAST(quarter(add_months(ps, -3)) AS STRING)) AS prior_quarter,
  concat(CAST(year(ps) - 1 AS STRING), '-Q', CAST(quarter(ps) AS STRING)) AS prior_year_quarter,
  quarter = '2026-Q3' AS is_current_cycle, quarter >= '2026-Q1' AS is_post_go_live
FROM cal_m WHERE miq = 3","type":"custom-sql"}

    CASE c.field_id
      WHEN 'ALL_NAV' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_ALL_NAV, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'ALL_CASH' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_ALL_CASH, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'ALL_MGMT_FEE' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_ALL_MGMT_FEE, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))

      WHEN 'ALL_TOTAL_EXP' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_ALL_TOTAL_EXP, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'ALL_NET_INCOME' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_ALL_NET_INCOME, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'ALL_EXP_RATIO' THEN CAST(try_divide(coalesce(a.v_ALL_TOTAL_EXP, 0) * 12 / p.month_in_quarter, a.v_ALL_NAV) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PE_VALUATION' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PE_VALUATION, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PE_UNREAL' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PE_UNREAL, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PE_REAL' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PE_REAL, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))

      WHEN 'PE_CALLED' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PE_CALLED, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PE_DIST' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PE_DIST, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PE_MOIC' THEN CAST(try_divide(a.x_pval, a.x_cost) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PE_COMPANIES' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(CASE e.client_short WHEN 'Northbridge' THEN 5 WHEN 'Halden' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'PE_CARRY' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PE_CARRY, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PC_LOANBOOK' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PC_LOANBOOK, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PC_INTEREST' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PC_INTEREST, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'PC_ACCRUED_INT' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PC_ACCRUED_INT, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))

      WHEN 'PC_FAC_INT' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_PC_FAC_INT, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))

      WHEN 'PC_ARREARS' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(0.006 + 0.005 * sin(p.period_index / 3.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0)) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'PC_BORROWERS' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(round(15 + 0.9 * sin(p.period_index / 6.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0))) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'PC_LTV' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(0.55 + 0.02 * sin(p.period_index / 5.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0)) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'PC_PROVISION' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(a.x_lb * (0.009 + 0.002 * sin(p.period_index / 4.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0))) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'RE_PROP_VALUE' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_PROP_VALUE, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_RENT' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_RENT, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_SERVICE_CHARGE' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_SERVICE_CHARGE, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_REVAL' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_REVAL, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_GROUND_RENT' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_GROUND_RENT, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_PM_FEES' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_PM_FEES, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_REPAIRS' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_REPAIRS, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_INSURANCE' THEN CAST(coalesce(a.v_RE_INSURANCE, 0) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_LTV' THEN CAST(try_divide(a.x_loan, a.x_prop) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_OCCUPANCY' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(0.93 + 0.02 * sin(p.period_index / 4.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0)) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'RE_WAULT' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(6.0 - 0.25 * pmod(p.quarter_index - 1, 5) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'RE_NIY' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(0.0545 + 0.0015 * sin(p.period_index / 4.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0)) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
    END AS value
  FROM ent e
  CROSS JOIN per p
  JOIN cat c ON c.fund_type = 'All' OR c.fund_type = e.fund_type
  LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.entity_id = e.entity_id AND a.period = p.period)
SELECT metric_key, entity_id, period, quarter, is_quarter_end, field_id, value,
  lag(value, 3) OVER w AS prior_quarter_value,
  lag(value, 12) OVER w AS prior_year_value,
  CASE month_in_quarter WHEN 1 THEN lag(value, 1) OVER w WHEN 2 THEN lag(value, 2) OVER w
       ELSE lag(value, 3) OVER w END AS value_prior_quarter_end
FROM base
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY entity_id, field_id ORDER BY period_index)","type":"custom-sql"}

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"sbase","definition":"-- One row per product: the base book the scenario modeler cross-joins against.
--
-- This has to be genuinely one row per product, NOT a grouped view over the
-- monthly loan book. A cross join operates on the underlying rows, so joining a
-- grouped 144-row table replicates each product once per month and inflates
-- every downstream sum by 24x.
--
-- Re-derives from the same constants as loan_book.sql, aggregated over the
-- trailing twelve months, so the two always agree.
WITH product AS (

        ROUND(p.bal_base * POWER(1 + p.annual_growth / 12, m.month_index)
              * (1 + 0.035 * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 12.0) + p.phase)), 2) AS bal,
        ROUND(p.fee_base * POWER(1 + p.annual_growth / 12, m.month_index)
              * (1 + 0.035 * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 12.0) + p.phase))
              * CASE WHEN p.product = 'Home Loans' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (4,5,6) THEN 1.180

    CAST(ROUND(AVG(funding_eff) * 100, 2) AS DECIMAL(6,2))       AS `Funding Pct`
FROM monthly

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"tbl-mp","definition":"-- Synthetic member-level population for the Cohort Builder page.
-- 2,600 members, deterministic (HASH-seeded, no RANDOM) so segment counts are
-- stable across runs and safe to quote live in a demo.
WITH seq AS (
    SELECT id AS i FROM range(2600)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        i,
        'M-' || LPAD(CAST(i + 100001 AS STRING), 7, '0') AS member_id,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 11) as bigint)) % 100 AS r_prod,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 22) as bigint)) % 100 AS r_age,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 33) as bigint)) % 100 AS r_region,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 44) as bigint)) % 100 AS r_credit,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 55) as bigint)) % 5   AS r_count,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 66) as bigint)) % 132 AS r_tenure,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 77) as bigint)) % 100 AS r_dd,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 88) as bigint)) % 100 AS r_engage,
        abs(cast(hash(i, 99) as bigint)) % 1000 AS r_bal
    FROM seq
),
labelled AS (
    SELECT
        member_id,
        CASE
            WHEN r_prod < 31 THEN 'Professional Liability'
            WHEN r_prod < 44 THEN 'Healthcare Liability'
            WHEN r_prod < 51 THEN 'Casualty'
            WHEN r_prod < 63 THEN 'Property & Energy'
            WHEN r_prod < 85 THEN 'Programs'
            ELSE 'Reinsurance'
        END AS primary_product,
        CASE
            WHEN r_age < 26 THEN '18-27'
            WHEN r_age < 58 THEN '28-37'
            WHEN r_age < 80 THEN '38-47'
            WHEN r_age < 93 THEN '48-57'
            ELSE '58+'
        END AS age_band,
        CASE
            WHEN r_region < 23 THEN 'North America'
            WHEN r_region < 43 THEN 'Bermuda'
            WHEN r_region < 60 THEN 'Europe & UK'
            WHEN r_region < 79 THEN 'Asia Pacific'
            ELSE 'Latin America'
        END AS region,
        -- SoFi skews prime / super-prime.
        CASE
            WHEN r_credit < 8  THEN 'Small Commercial'
            WHEN r_credit < 34 THEN 'Middle Market'
            WHEN r_credit < 72 THEN 'Large Account'
            ELSE 'Global Program'
        END AS credit_band,
        CASE
            WHEN r_credit < 8  THEN 1
            WHEN r_credit < 34 THEN 2
            WHEN r_credit < 72 THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END AS credit_order,
        r_count + 1 AS products_held,
        ROUND(r_tenure / 12.0, 1) AS tenure_years,
        CASE WHEN r_dd < 43 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS direct_deposit,
        CASE
            WHEN r_engage < 34 THEN 'Frequent'
            WHEN r_engage < 68 THEN 'Periodic'
            WHEN r_engage < 89 THEN 'Occasional'
            ELSE 'None'
        END AS engagement,
        CASE
            WHEN r_engage < 34 THEN 1
            WHEN r_engage < 68 THEN 2
            WHEN r_engage < 89 THEN 3
            ELSE 4
        END AS engagement_order,
        r_count, r_bal, r_credit, r_tenure, r_dd
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    member_id                        AS `Member ID`,
    primary_product                  AS `Primary Product`,
    age_band                         AS `Age Band`,
    region                           AS `Region`,
    credit_band                      AS `Credit Band`,
    credit_order                     AS `Credit Order`,
    products_held                    AS `Products Held`,
    tenure_years                     AS `Tenure Years`,
    direct_deposit                   AS `Direct Deposit`,
    engagement                       AS `Engagement`,
    engagement_order                 AS `Engagement Order`,
    -- Balances scale with credit quality and product depth.
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN credit_band = 'Small Commercial'  THEN 28000
            WHEN credit_band = 'Middle Market'       THEN 145000
            WHEN credit_band = 'Large Account' THEN 720000
            ELSE 3400000
        END
        * (1 + products_held * 0.16)
        * (0.55 + r_bal / 1000.0 * 0.9)
    , 0)                             AS `Total Balances`,
    -- Annual revenue per member, roughly 4-6% of balances plus a fee component.
    ROUND(
        (CASE
            WHEN credit_band = 'Small Commercial'  THEN 28000
            WHEN credit_band = 'Middle Market'       THEN 145000
            WHEN credit_band = 'Large Account' THEN 720000
            ELSE 3400000
         END
         * (1 + products_held * 0.16)
         * (0.55 + r_bal / 1000.0 * 0.9)) * 0.78
        + products_held * 9500
    , 0)                             AS `Annual Revenue`,
    -- Attrition falls with tenure, products, direct deposit and engagement.
    ROUND(LEAST(0.93, GREATEST(0.01,
        0.36
        - 0.019 * tenure_years
        - 0.041 * products_held
        - CASE WHEN direct_deposit = 'Yes' THEN 0.085 ELSE 0 END
        - CASE engagement WHEN 'Frequent' THEN 0.075 WHEN 'Periodic' THEN 0.045
                          WHEN 'Occasional' THEN 0.010 ELSE -0.070 END
        + (r_bal % 100) / 1000.0
    )), 3)                           AS `Attrition Propensity`
FROM labelled
","type":"custom-sql"}

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"tbl-lbc","definition":"-- SoFi loan book & fee businesses: 6 product lines x 24 months.
-- Pure generated SQL (no source tables) so it compiles on any Snowflake
-- connection. Amounts in $MM. Calibrated to SoFi's real scale: ~$3.5-3.9B
-- annual adjusted net revenue, ~$33B average balances, ~14M members.
-- Balance type matters to the economics: only lending products carry an asset
-- yield and a funding cost. SoFi Money holds DEPOSITS -- a funding source, not an
-- earning asset -- so it earns fee/interchange revenue and bears no interest
-- expense of its own; the cheap funding it provides is already reflected in the
-- lending products' low cost of funds. Modelling deposits as a 0%-yield asset
-- would book a large phantom interest expense against them.
WITH product AS (
    SELECT 'Professional Liability' AS product, 1 AS product_order, 'U.S. Insurance' AS balance_type, 1520 AS bal_base, 0.8 AS yield_rate, 0.496 AS funding_rate, 3.4 AS fee_base, 0.012 AS provision_rate, 0.042 AS delinq_rate, 0.72 AS opex_ratio, 0.045 AS annual_growth, 596 AS members_base, 0.0 AS phase
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Healthcare Liability', 2, 'U.S. Insurance', 1010, 0.82, 0.558, 2.1, 0.0165, 0.061, 0.7, 0.038, 214, 1.1
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Casualty', 3, 'U.S. Insurance', 1330, 0.78, 0.507, 2.6, 0.014, 0.055, 0.715, 0.052, 338, 2.2
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Property & Energy', 4, 'International Insurance', 1150, 0.7, 0.385, 3.9, 0.006, 0.028, 0.745, 0.068, 172, 0.6
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Programs', 5, 'U.S. Insurance', 780, 0.55, 0.33, 4.2, 0.008, 0.036, 0.76, 0.082, 505, 1.7
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Reinsurance', 6, 'Reinsurance', 1010, 0.88, 0.51, 1.9, 0.011, 0.047, 0.69, 0.026, 41, 2.8
),
states AS (
    SELECT 'United States' AS state, 0.4222 AS state_share
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United Kingdom', 0.1222
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Bermuda', 0.1111
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Switzerland', 0.0444
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Canada', 0.0556
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Australia', 0.0444
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Ireland', 0.0333
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Singapore', 0.0333
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Hong Kong', 0.0333
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Germany', 0.0278
    UNION ALL SELECT 'France', 0.0222
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Netherlands', 0.0167
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Brazil', 0.0167
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Mexico', 0.0111
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Japan', 0.0057
),
months AS (
    -- 24 complete months ending 2026-07
    SELECT add_months(DATE '2024-08-01', id) AS period_month,
           id AS month_index
    FROM range(24)
),
grid AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        g.state,
        g.state_share,
        -- deterministic per-state tilt so each state has its own story
        (MOD(abs(cast(hash(g.state || p.product) as bigint)), 21) - 10) / 100.0 AS state_tilt,
        m.period_month,
        m.month_index,
        POWER(1 + p.annual_growth / 12, m.month_index) AS trend,
        1 + 0.035 * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 12.0) + p.phase) AS seasonal,
        -- Home lending is rate-sensitive: originations spike in the spring.
        CASE WHEN p.product = 'Home Loans' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (4, 5, 6) THEN 1.180
             WHEN p.product = 'Credit Card' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (11, 12) THEN 1.140
             ELSE 1.0 END AS event_factor
    FROM product p CROSS JOIN months m CROSS JOIN states g
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        product, product_order, balance_type, state, state_tilt, period_month, month_index, delinq_rate,
        yield_rate, funding_rate,
        -- 2dp, NOT 0dp: a company whose smallest line is GBP 2.1m in a
        -- 12-region footprint has per-row volumes below 0.5, and whole-unit
        -- rounding erased the line entirely (Which? Trusted Traders & Legal
        -- reported exactly zero) while rounding others UP by 70%.
        ROUND(bal_base * state_share * (1 + state_tilt) * trend * seasonal, 2) AS avg_balances,
        ROUND(fee_base * state_share * (1 + state_tilt) * trend * seasonal * event_factor, 2) AS fee_income,
        ROUND(members_base * state_share * POWER(1 + 0.075 / 12, month_index), 0) AS members_k,
        -- Originations run roughly 6% of balances a month for lending products.
        ROUND(bal_base * state_share * 0.060 * trend * seasonal * event_factor, 1) AS originations,
        provision_rate, opex_ratio,
        -- Funding cost eases ~45bps over the two years as rates come down.
        funding_rate - 0.0045 * (month_index / 23.0)            AS funding_eff
    FROM grid
),
fin AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        ROUND(avg_balances * yield_rate / 12, 2)                        AS interest_income,
        ROUND(avg_balances * funding_eff / 12, 2)                       AS interest_expense,
        ROUND(avg_balances * provision_rate / 12, 2)                    AS provision
    FROM calc c
)
SELECT
    product                                                    AS `Product`,
    product_order                                              AS `Product Order`,
    balance_type                                               AS `Balance Type`,
    state                                                      AS `State`,
    ROUND(1 + state_tilt * 1.6, 3)                             AS `Performance Index`,
    period_month                                               AS `Period`,
    YEAR(period_month)                                         AS `Year`,
    concat('Q', CAST(quarter(period_month) AS STRING))                               AS `Quarter`,
    CASE WHEN month_index >= 12 THEN 'Current Period'
         ELSE 'Prior Period' END                               AS `Period Name`,
    members_k                                                  AS `Members (K)`,
    originations                                               AS `Originations`,
    avg_balances                                               AS `Avg Balances`,
    interest_income                                            AS `Interest Income`,
    interest_expense                                           AS `Interest Expense`,
    ROUND(interest_income - interest_expense, 2)               AS `Net Interest Income`,
    fee_income                                                 AS `Fee Income`,
    ROUND(interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income, 2)  AS `Net Revenue`,
    provision                                                  AS `Provision`,
    ROUND((interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income) * opex_ratio, 2) AS `Opex`,
    ROUND(interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income
          - provision
          - (interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income) * opex_ratio, 2)
                                                               AS `Contribution Profit`,
    ROUND(delinq_rate, 4)                                      AS `Delinquency Rate`,
    ROUND(yield_rate * 100, 2)                                 AS `Yield Pct`,
    ROUND(funding_eff * 100, 2)                                AS `Funding Cost Pct`,
    ROUND((yield_rate - funding_eff) * 100, 2)                 AS `Spread Pct`
FROM fin
","type":"custom-sql"}

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"tbl-rh","definition":"-- Benchmark rate history, 24 months. Illustrative values anchored to the real
-- rate environment (Treasury 10Y ~4.65%, 30Y ~5.19% as of 2026-08-07) so the
-- charts agree with the live ticker rather than contradicting it.
-- The ticker plugin fetches genuinely live yields; this table is the history
-- behind them and the fallback if the live fetch is unavailable.
WITH benchmark AS (
    SELECT '10Y Treasury' AS benchmark, 1 AS bench_order, 4.65 AS end_rate, -0.55 AS drift, 0.10 AS vol, 0.0 AS phase
    UNION ALL SELECT '2Y Treasury',   2, 4.19, -0.95, 0.12, 0.7
    UNION ALL SELECT 'SOFR',          3, 4.31, -1.10, 0.08, 1.3
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Fed Funds',     4, 4.50, -1.00, 0.05, 1.3
    UNION ALL SELECT '30Y Mortgage',  5, 6.42, -0.70, 0.14, 0.2
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Prime',         6, 7.50, -1.00, 0.05, 1.3
),
months AS (
    SELECT add_months(DATE '2024-08-01', id) AS period_month,
           id AS month_index
    FROM range(24)
)
SELECT
    b.benchmark                                      AS `Benchmark`,
    b.bench_order                                    AS `Benchmark Order`,
    m.period_month                                   AS `Period`,
    -- Walk backwards from today's real level along the drift, with a small
    -- deterministic wave so the series isn't a straight line.
    ROUND(b.end_rate - b.drift * ((23 - m.month_index) / 23.0)
          + b.vol * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 9.0) + b.phase), 3)
                                                     AS `Rate Pct`,
    CASE WHEN m.month_index >= 12 THEN 'Current Period'
         ELSE 'Prior Period' END                     AS `Period Name`
FROM benchmark b CROSS JOIN months m
","type":"custom-sql"}

    UNION ALL SELECT 'Property & Energy', 4, 'International Insurance', 1150, 0.7, 0.385, 3.9, 0.006, 0.028, 0.745, 0.068, 172, 0.6
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Programs', 5, 'U.S. Insurance', 780, 0.55, 0.33, 4.2, 0.008, 0.036, 0.76, 0.082, 505, 1.7
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Reinsurance', 6, 'Reinsurance', 1010, 0.88, 0.51, 1.9, 0.011, 0.047, 0.69, 0.026, 41, 2.8
),
states AS (
    SELECT 'United States' AS state, 0.4222 AS state_share
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United Kingdom', 0.1222
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Bermuda', 0.1111
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Switzerland', 0.0444
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Canada', 0.0556
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Australia', 0.0444
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Ireland', 0.0333
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Singapore', 0.0333
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Hong Kong', 0.0333
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Germany', 0.0278
    UNION ALL SELECT 'France', 0.0222
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Netherlands', 0.0167
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Brazil', 0.0167
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Mexico', 0.0111
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Japan', 0.0057
),
months AS (
    -- 24 complete months ending 2026-07
    SELECT add_months(DATE '2024-08-01', id) AS period_month,
           id AS month_index
    FROM range(24)
),
grid AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        g.state,
        g.state_share,
        -- deterministic per-state tilt so each state has its own story
        (MOD(abs(cast(hash(g.state || p.product) as bigint)), 21) - 10) / 100.0 AS state_tilt,
        m.period_month,
        m.month_index,
        POWER(1 + p.annual_growth / 12, m.month_index) AS trend,
        1 + 0.035 * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 12.0) + p.phase) AS seasonal,
        -- Home lending is rate-sensitive: originations spike in the spring.
        CASE WHEN p.product = 'Home Loans' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (4, 5, 6) THEN 1.180
             WHEN p.product = 'Credit Card' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (11, 12) THEN 1.140
             ELSE 1.0 END AS event_factor
    FROM product p CROSS JOIN months m CROSS JOIN states g
),
calc AS (
    SELECT
        product, product_order, balance_type, state, state_tilt, period_month, month_index, delinq_rate,
        yield_rate, funding_rate,
        -- 2dp, NOT 0dp: a company whose smallest line is GBP 2.1m in a
        -- 12-region footprint has per-row volumes below 0.5, and whole-unit
        -- rounding erased the line entirely (Which? Trusted Traders & Legal
        -- reported exactly zero) while rounding others UP by 70%.
        ROUND(bal_base * state_share * (1 + state_tilt) * trend * seasonal, 2) AS avg_balances,
        ROUND(fee_base * state_share * (1 + state_tilt) * trend * seasonal * event_factor, 2) AS fee_income,
        ROUND(members_base * state_share * POWER(1 + 0.075 / 12, month_index), 0) AS members_k,
        -- Originations run roughly 6% of balances a month for lending products.
        ROUND(bal_base * state_share * 0.060 * trend * seasonal * event_factor, 1) AS originations,
        provision_rate, opex_ratio,
        -- Funding cost eases ~45bps over the two years as rates come down.
        funding_rate - 0.0045 * (month_index / 23.0)            AS funding_eff
    FROM grid
),
fin AS (
    SELECT
        c.*,
        ROUND(avg_balances * yield_rate / 12, 2)                        AS interest_income,
        ROUND(avg_balances * funding_eff / 12, 2)                       AS interest_expense,
        ROUND(avg_balances * provision_rate / 12, 2)                    AS provision
    FROM calc c
)
SELECT
    product                                                    AS `Product`,
    product_order                                              AS `Product Order`,
    balance_type                                               AS `Balance Type`,
    state                                                      AS `State`,
    ROUND(1 + state_tilt * 1.6, 3)                             AS `Performance Index`,
    period_month                                               AS `Period`,
    YEAR(period_month)                                         AS `Year`,
    concat('Q', CAST(quarter(period_month) AS STRING))                               AS `Quarter`,
    CASE WHEN month_index >= 12 THEN 'Current Period'
         ELSE 'Prior Period' END                               AS `Period Name`,
    members_k                                                  AS `Members (K)`,
    originations                                               AS `Originations`,
    avg_balances                                               AS `Avg Balances`,
    interest_income                                            AS `Interest Income`,
    interest_expense                                           AS `Interest Expense`,
    ROUND(interest_income - interest_expense, 2)               AS `Net Interest Income`,
    fee_income                                                 AS `Fee Income`,
    ROUND(interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income, 2)  AS `Net Revenue`,
    provision                                                  AS `Provision`,
    ROUND((interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income) * opex_ratio, 2) AS `Opex`,
    ROUND(interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income
          - provision
          - (interest_income - interest_expense + fee_income) * opex_ratio, 2)
                                                               AS `Contribution Profit`,
    ROUND(delinq_rate, 4)                                      AS `Delinquency Rate`,
    ROUND(yield_rate * 100, 2)                                 AS `Yield Pct`,
    ROUND(funding_eff * 100, 2)                                AS `Funding Cost Pct`,
    ROUND((yield_rate - funding_eff) * 100, 2)                 AS `Spread Pct`
FROM fin
","type":"custom-sql"}

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"tbl-nb","definition":"-- Net revenue -> contribution profit bridge for the waterfall chart.
-- Re-derives from the same product constants as loan_book.sql so the two agree;
-- aggregates the trailing-twelve-month window into signed bridge steps ($MM).
WITH product AS (
    SELECT 'Personal Loans' AS product, 17500 AS bal_base, 0.1320 AS yield_rate, 0.0410 AS funding_rate,
           22.0 AS fee_base, 0.0360 AS provision_rate, 0.380 AS opex_ratio, 0.052 AS annual_growth, 0.0 AS phase
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Student Refinancing',  9800, 0.0640, 0.0410,  6.0, 0.0050, 0.340, 0.028, 1.1
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Home Loans',           4200, 0.0680, 0.0410, 14.0, 0.0030, 0.520, 0.115, 2.2
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Credit Card',          1150, 0.2150, 0.0410,  5.0, 0.0850, 0.460, 0.140, 0.6
    UNION ALL SELECT 'SoFi Money',          38000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 45.0, 0.0000, 0.620, 0.180, 1.7
    UNION ALL SELECT 'SoFi Invest',             0, 0.0000, 0.0000, 18.0, 0.0000, 0.700, 0.095, 2.8
),
months AS (
    SELECT add_months(DATE '2024-08-01', id) AS period_month, id AS month_index
    FROM range(24)
),
bridge_rows AS (
    SELECT
        p.product, m.month_index,
        ROUND(p.bal_base * POWER(1 + p.annual_growth / 12, m.month_index)
              * (1 + 0.035 * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 12.0) + p.phase)), 0) AS bal,
        ROUND(p.fee_base * POWER(1 + p.annual_growth / 12, m.month_index)
              * (1 + 0.035 * SIN(2 * PI() * (m.month_index / 12.0) + p.phase))
              * CASE WHEN p.product = 'Home Loans' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (4,5,6) THEN 1.180
                     WHEN p.product = 'Credit Card' AND MONTH(m.period_month) IN (11,12) THEN 1.140
                     ELSE 1.0 END, 2) AS fee,
        p.yield_rate,
        CASE WHEN p.funding_rate > 0 THEN p.funding_rate - 0.0045 * (m.month_index / 23.0) ELSE 0 END AS funding_eff,
        p.provision_rate, p.opex_ratio
    FROM product p CROSS JOIN months m
    WHERE m.month_index >= 12          -- trailing twelve months only
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(bal * yield_rate / 12)                                        AS interest_income,
        SUM(bal * funding_eff / 12)                                       AS interest_expense,
        SUM(fee)                                                          AS fee_income,
        SUM(bal * provision_rate / 12)                                    AS provision,
        SUM((bal * yield_rate / 12 - bal * funding_eff / 12 + fee) * opex_ratio) AS opex
    FROM bridge_rows
)
SELECT CAST(step AS STRING) AS `Step`,
       CAST(step_order AS DECIMAL(38,0)) AS `Step Order`,
       CAST(ROUND(amount, 1) AS DECIMAL(12,1)) AS `Amount`,
       CAST(step_type AS STRING) AS `Step Type`
FROM (
    SELECT 'Interest Income'      AS step, 1 AS step_order, interest_income        AS amount, 'start' AS step_type FROM agg
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Interest Expense', 2, -interest_expense, 'decrease' FROM agg
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Fee Income',       3,  fee_income,      'increase' FROM agg
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Provision',        4, -provision,       'decrease' FROM agg
    UNION ALL SELECT 'Opex',             5, -opex,            'decrease' FROM agg
    -- No explicit total row: the waterfall renders its own End bar, so adding
    -- one here draws the total twice.
)
","type":"custom-sql"}

SELECT 
  cloud, 
  CASE 
    WHEN instr(sku_name,'PREMIUM_SQL_PRO') > 0 THEN 'Pro'
    ELSE 'Classic' 
  END AS SQL_Warehouse_Type,
  CASE
    WHEN get_json_object(to_json(usage_metadata), '$["node_type"]') = 'db.xxsmall' THEN '2X-Small'
    WHEN get_json_object(to_json(usage_metadata), '$["node_type"]') = 'db.small' THEN 'Small'
    WHEN get_json_object(to_json(usage_metadata), '$["node_type"]') = 'db.medium' THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE 'Large'
  END AS SQL_Warehouse_Size, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT get_json_object(to_json(usage_metadata), '$["warehouse_id"]')) AS num_warehouses,
  CAST(SUM(date_diff(hour, usage_start_time, usage_end_time)) / COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS total_hours_per_day,
  CAST(SUM(date_diff(hour, usage_start_time, usage_end_time)) / COUNT(DISTINCT usage_date) / COUNT(DISTINCT get_json_object(to_json(usage_metadata), '$["warehouse_id"]')) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS warehouse_hours_per_day
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE instr(lower(sku_name),'sql') > 0

{"connectionId":"d994daa5-d277-462c-8e3b-f6200c981e23","customSqlId":"tbl","definition":"WITH b0 AS (

    -- weighted tilts off ORDER_NUMBER (many distinct -> even 100-bucket roll), so no sector
    -- is starved the way a skewed PRODUCT_FAMILY hash left Industrials near-empty.
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),9)),100)<24 THEN 0 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),9)),100)<42 THEN 1 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),9)),100)<59 THEN 2 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),9)),100)<71 THEN 3 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),9)),100)<86 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS SEC_IDX,
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),4)),100)<55 THEN 0 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),4)),100)<75 THEN 1 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),4)),100)<90 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS STR_IDX,
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(STORE_STATE),5)),100)<60 THEN 0 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(STORE_STATE),5)),100)<85 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS GEO_IDX,
    CASE WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(CUSTOMER_NAME),6)),100)<55 THEN 0 WHEN MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(CUSTOMER_NAME),6)),100)<85 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS CAP_IDX,
    MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(CUSTOMER_NAME))),6) AS TK_SUB,
    MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),1)),100) AS SIDE_ROLL,
    (0.4 + MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),2)),1000)/1000.0) AS EXPW,
    ((MOD(ABS(HASH(TO_VARCHAR(ORDER_NUMBER),3)),1000)/1000.0) - 0.42) AS SKILL_W
  FROM EXAMPLES.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS_HANDS_ON_LAB_DATA
  WHERE PRODUCT_FAMILY IS NOT NULL AND PRODUCT_LINE IS NOT NULL AND STORE_STATE IS NOT NULL
    AND ORDER_NUMBER IS NOT NULL AND CUSTOMER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND DATE IS NOT NULL
), mm AS (SELECT MIN(USE_MONTH) MINM, MAX(USE_MONTH) MAXM FROM b0),
dims AS (
  SELECT b0.*, mm.MAXM,
    DATEDIFF('month', mm.MINM, b0.USE_MONTH) AS MI,
    DATEDIFF('month', mm.MINM, mm.MAXM) AS TM,
    DATEDIFF('month', b0.USE_MONTH, mm.MAXM) AS MB,
    GET(ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('Information Technology','Health Care','Financials','Energy','Consumer Discretionary','Industrials'), SEC_IDX)::string AS SECTOR,

    GET(ARRAY_CONSTRUCT('Large Cap','Mid Cap','Small Cap'), CAP_IDX)::string AS MKT_CAP,

    CASE WHEN SIDE_ROLL < 66 THEN 'Long' ELSE 'Short' END AS SIDE
  FROM b0 CROSS JOIN mm
), rt AS (
  SELECT dims.*,
    4.9e9 / POWER(1.007, MB) AS AUM_M,
    (1.80 + 0.25*MI/NULLIF(TM,0)) AS GROSS_R,
    (0.30 + 0.14*MI/NULLIF(TM,0) + 0.03*SIN(MI/2.0)) AS NET_R,

  FROM dims

    SUM(EXPW)    OVER (PARTITION BY USE_MONTH, SIDE) AS EXPW_SUM,
    SUM(SKILL_W) OVER (PARTITION BY USE_MONTH)       AS SKILL_SUM
  FROM rt

  SELECT wsum.*,
    (CASE WHEN SIDE='Long' THEN (GROSS_R+NET_R)/2.0 ELSE (GROSS_R-NET_R)/2.0 END)*AUM_M AS SIDE_BOOK,
    EXPW/NULLIF(EXPW_SUM,0) AS EXP_FRAC
  FROM wsum
), fin AS (
  SELECT pos.*,
    EXP_FRAC*SIDE_BOOK AS MV_ABS,
    (CASE WHEN SIDE='Long' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END)*EXP_FRAC*SIDE_BOOK AS MV_SIGNED,
    (CASE WHEN SKILL_SUM=0 THEN 0 ELSE SKILL_W/SKILL_SUM END)*(RET_M*AUM_M) AS PNL_M
  FROM pos
)
SELECT DATE, USE_MONTH,
  CASE WHEN MB < 12 THEN 'Current Period' WHEN MB < 24 THEN 'Prior Year' ELSE NULL END AS PERIOD_NAME,

  (CASE WHEN MB < 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IS_YTD,
  (CASE WHEN MB >= 12 AND MB < 24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IS_PYTD,
  (CASE WHEN MB = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IS_CUR,
  (CASE WHEN MB = 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IS_PRI
FROM fin","type":"custom-sql"}

{"connectionId":"76dc7f5b-1f24-42cd-a21c-1b1a6dfc1b30","customSqlId":"ES5MSuLqri","definition":"WITH RECURSIVE EmpHierarchy AS (
    -- 1. Base Case: Identifying the root Managing Directors
    SELECT 
        ee_id, name, email, manager_ee_id,
        -- MD Details (Locked in here)
        ee_id AS md_ee_id, 
        name AS md_name, 
        email AS md_email,
        -- Level 1 & 2 start as NULL for the MDs themselves
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS l1_ee_id,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS l1_name,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS l1_email,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS l2_ee_id,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS l2_name,
        CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS l2_email,
        1 AS depth,
        ARRAY(ee_id) AS id_path, -- Track path to detect loops
        FALSE AS is_cycle
    FROM sigma_element('Employee List')
    WHERE is_md = TRUE OR is_md = 'true'

    UNION ALL

    -- 2. Recursive Step: Walking down the reporting chain
    SELECT 
        e.ee_id, e.name, e.email, e.manager_ee_id,
        h.md_ee_id, h.md_name, h.md_email, 
        
        -- Identify Level 1 (First report under MD)
        CASE WHEN h.depth = 1 THEN e.ee_id ELSE h.l1_ee_id END AS l1_ee_id,
        CASE WHEN h.depth = 1 THEN e.name  ELSE h.l1_name  END AS l1_name,
        CASE WHEN h.depth = 1 THEN e.email ELSE h.l1_email END AS l1_email,
        
        -- Identify Level 2 (Second report under MD / First report under L1)
        CASE WHEN h.depth = 2 THEN e.ee_id ELSE h.l2_ee_id END AS l2_ee_id,
        CASE WHEN h.depth = 2 THEN e.name  ELSE h.l2_name  END AS l2_name,
        CASE WHEN h.depth = 2 THEN e.email ELSE h.l2_email END AS l2_email,
        
        h.depth + 1 AS depth,
        ARRAY_APPEND(h.id_path, e.ee_id) AS id_path,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(h.id_path, e.ee_id) AS is_cycle
    FROM sigma_element('Employee List') e
    INNER JOIN EmpHierarchy h ON e.manager_ee_id = h.ee_id
    WHERE h.is_cycle = FALSE AND h.depth < 15 -- Safety limit
)
-- 3. Final Selection with Multi-Level Self-Exclusion
SELECT 
    ee_id, 
    name, 
    email,
    -- MD Exclusion: If you ARE the MD, these return NULL
    IF(ee_id = md_ee_id, NULL, md_ee_id) AS md_ee_id,
    IF(ee_id = md_ee_id, NULL, md_name)  AS md_name,
    IF(ee_id = md_ee_id, NULL, md_email) AS md_email,
    -- Level 1 Exclusion: If you ARE the Level 1, these return NULL

    IF(ee_id = l1_ee_id, NULL, l1_name)  AS l1_name,
    IF(ee_id = l1_ee_id, NULL, l1_email) AS l1_email,
    -- Level 2 Exclusion: If you ARE the Level 2, these return NULL
    IF(ee_id = l2_ee_id, NULL, l2_ee_id) AS l2_ee_id,
    IF(ee_id = l2_ee_id, NULL, l2_name)  AS l2_name,
    IF(ee_id = l2_ee_id, NULL, l2_email) AS l2_email,
    depth,
    is_cycle
FROM EmpHierarchy","type":"custom-sql"}

  t.entity_id, e.client_name, e.client_short, e.entity_name, e.base_ccy,
  t.period, t.pe AS period_end, t.quarter, t.miq = 3 AS is_quarter_end, t.fy AS fiscal_year,
  t.account_code, t.account_name, t.account_class, t.normal_balance, t.is_pl,
  CAST(t.closing - t.mv AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS opening_balance,
  CAST(t.mv AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS period_movement,
  CAST(t.closing AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS closing_balance,
  t.lt_cum AS load_timestamp,
  CAST(t.qtd AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS qtd_movement,
  CAST(t.ytd AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ytd_movement,
  CAST(t.cpp AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS closing_prior_period,
  CAST(t.cpq AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS closing_prior_quarter,
  CAST(t.cpy AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS closing_prior_year,
  CAST(CASE WHEN s.entity_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.closing - (aggregate(filter(t.late, x -> x.idx <= t.idx AND x.ts > s.reported_at AND (NOT t.is_pl OR x.fy = t.fy)), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,2)), (acc, x) -> CAST(acc + x.amt AS DECIMAL(38,2))) + CASE WHEN t.account_code = '3020' THEN aggregate(filter(t.late_pl, x -> x.fy < t.fy AND x.ts > s.reported_at), CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38,2)), (acc, x) -> CAST(acc + x.amt AS DECIMAL(38,2))) ELSE 0 END) END AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS reported_closing,
  CAST(t.qtd_pq AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS qtd_movement_prior_quarter,
  s.entity_id IS NOT NULL AS is_reported,
  CAST(t.n_lines AS INT) AS gl_line_count
FROM tb t
JOIN p_ent e ON e.entity_id = t.entity_id
LEFT JOIN snap s ON s.entity_id = t.entity_id AND s.period = t.period
WHERE t.idx >= 1 AND (t.closing <> 0 OR t.mv <> 0 OR t.n_lines > 0)),

      WHEN 'RE_LTV' THEN CAST(try_divide(a.x_loan, a.x_prop) AS DECIMAL(24,6))
      WHEN 'RE_OCCUPANCY' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(0.93 + 0.02 * sin(p.period_index / 4.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0)) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'RE_WAULT' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(6.0 - 0.25 * pmod(p.quarter_index - 1, 5) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
      WHEN 'RE_NIY' THEN CASE WHEN e.entity_type = 'GP' THEN CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(24,6)) ELSE CAST(0.0545 + 0.0015 * sin(p.period_index / 4.0 + (pmod(xxhash64((CASE e.entity_id WHEN 'KP-FD' THEN 'KP-LP' WHEN 'HG-FD' THEN 'HG-LP' ELSE e.entity_id END), c.field_id), 628) / 100.0)) AS DECIMAL(24,6)) END
    END AS value
  FROM ent e
  CROSS JOIN per p
  JOIN cat c ON c.fund_type = 'All' OR c.fund_type = e.fund_type
  LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.entity_id = e.entity_id AND a.period = p.period)
SELECT metric_key, entity_id, period, quarter, is_quarter_end, field_id, value,
  lag(value, 3) OVER w AS prior_quarter_value,
  lag(value, 12) OVER w AS prior_year_value,
  CASE month_in_quarter WHEN 1 THEN lag(value, 1) OVER w WHEN 2 THEN lag(value, 2) OVER w
       ELSE lag(value, 3) OVER w END AS value_prior_quarter_end
FROM base

{"connectionId":"a930af64-1922-490e-a0ee-b8aeacba0495","customSqlId":"src-periods","definition":"WITH cal_m AS (
  SELECT id + 1 AS idx, add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id) AS ps, last_day(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS pe,
         date_format(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id), 'yyyy-MM') AS period,
         date_format(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id), 'yyMM') AS yymm,
         date_format(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id), 'MMM yyyy') AS mlabel,
         concat(CAST(year(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING), '-Q', CAST(quarter(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING)) AS quarter,
         concat('Q', CAST(quarter(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING), ' ', CAST(year(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) AS STRING)) AS qlabel,
         pmod(month(add_months(DATE'2024-10-01', id)) - 1, 3) + 1 AS miq
  FROM (SELECT CAST(id AS INT) AS id FROM range(24)) r)
SELECT period, ps AS period_start, pe AS period_end, mlabel AS month_label, quarter,
  qlabel AS quarter_label, last_day(add_months(ps, 3 - miq)) AS quarter_end, miq AS month_in_quarter,
  miq = 3 AS is_quarter_end, year(ps) AS fiscal_year, idx AS period_index, CAST(ceil(idx / 3) AS INT) AS quarter_index,
  date_format(add_months(ps, -1), 'yyyy-MM') AS prior_period,
  date_format(add_months(ps, -miq), 'yyyy-MM') AS prior_quarter_end_period,
  date_format(add_months(ps, -12), 'yyyy-MM') AS prior_year_period,
  quarter = '2026-Q3' AS is_current_cycle, period = '2026-09' AS is_latest_period
FROM cal_m","type":"custom-sql"}
